description: Atlyn Variance Chart helps Power BI authors explain performance changes with clear, executive-ready variance visuals inspired by IBCS conventions. Build actual-versus-prior, plan, or forecast comparisons and choose from column, bar, line, area, combo, waterfall, dot, and lollipop styles from a single visual. Key features: - 10+ variance chart styles from one visual - Absolute and percentage variance with consistent positive/negative styling - Data labels, reference lines, and rich hover tooltips - Formatting pane control over colors, styles, and layout; high-contrast and theme aware; keyboard accessible Common uses: budget-versus-actual reporting, year-over-year performance, forecast tracking, and contribution analysis for leadership reviews. Interactivity: click a data point to select and cross-filter other visuals, hover for tooltips, and right-click for the standard context menu. The included sample report demonstrates a competitive marketing scenario with interactive filtering, tooltips, and polished formatting. Licensing: This visual is free to download and evaluate from Microsoft AppSource. Continued commercial use requires a paid AtlynCo subscription after a 30-day free trial. See https://www.atlynco.com/pricing for plans and pricing. Microsoft does not manage licensing or billing for this visual; subscriptions are handled independently by AtlynCo.
